name: ToggleSwitch
description: Accessible on/off switch with a spring-driven thumb, three sizes, custom accent track color and both controlled and uncontrolled usage.
a11yNotes: Renders a <button role="switch"> with aria-checked; the visible label is part of the button so it is the accessible name (falls back to aria-label "Toggle"). Space/Enter toggle natively, disabled uses the native attribute, and prefers-reduced-motion moves the thumb instantly.

propsApi.name: onCheckedChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next state when toggled.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Visible label, also the accessible name.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Extra class merged onto the root button.
